children: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. (NASDAQ:EMAT) is rapidly scaling both production and power for rare earth magnets—signing ULVAC equipment deals to reach 10,000 tons (6,000 tons high‑performance) while expanding its plant, boosting power to ~750 MW, buying 1.3M sq ft and landing a $20.7M regional grant.
Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. Signs ULVAC Equipment Deals
: EMAT signed equipment deals with ULVAC to scale annual rare earth magnet capacity to 10,000 tons, including 6,000 tons for high-performance sintered magnets, expanding manufacturing capability.
Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. Expands Power Capacity
: EMAT expands project: power capacity rising from 130 MW to ~750 MW, acquiring ~1.3M sq ft of adjacent land from Pohang, and securing a ~$20.7M grant from Pohang and Gyeongbuk.
